claim: Blood's 251 paired links fall into three geometries: WATER (191 pairs, 24 maps), a congruent copy of the room parked far away and dived into (median offset 81 player widths, 7% overlap in plan); STACK (38 pairs, 20 maps), one room directly above another (median offset 0.8 widths, 66% overlap); and plain LINK (22 pairs, 12 maps). Congruence is not required: 15 of 38 stacks join differently shaped sectors; what must line up is the part you walk over.
evidence: tools/mine_stacks.py over the 43 campaign maps, knowledge/blood/design/stacks-v1.json (bloodmap/roomoverroom.py docstring)
use: Build a stack with roomoverroom from one declaration; a water room is a separate copy elsewhere.
